name: Sleeker Editor Admin Menu
author: Sleeker UI/UX Design

sections.description:
Sleeker Editor Admin Menu is a powerful yet lightweight admin menu customizer designed to give administrators full control over the admin menu visibility for the Editor role. With an intuitive interface and easy-to-use checkboxes, you can hide specific menu items for Editors, ensuring a cleaner, more focused admin experience for the Editor role.

Key Features of the Sleeker Editor Admin Menu Plugin:

  • Remove All Posts from the left menu
  • Remove Add New Post from the left menu
  • Remove Categories from the left menu
  • Remove Tags from the left menu
  • Remove Media from the left menu
  • Remove Pages from the left menu
  • Remove Comments from the left menu
  • Remove Profile from the left menu
  • Remove Tools from the left menu
  • Remove New from the toolbar
  • Remove Post from the toolbar
  • Remove Media from the toolbar
  • Remove Pages from the toolbar
  • Remove Comments from the toolbar
  • Remove Edit Profile from the toolbar

Why Use Sleeker Editor Admin Menu Plugin?

  • Enhances User Experience: Removes unnecessary options for the Editor role, preventing confusion and improving workflow.
  • Improves Security: Restricts access to areas that Editors don’t need to see or modify.
  • Keeps the Admin Panel Sleeker and Cleaner: Helps declutter the dashboard, ensuring only relevant options are visible.
  • No Coding Required: Simple checkbox-based settings — no need to modify theme files or write custom code.
  • Lightweight and Efficient: Doesn’t slow down your site and works seamlessly with WordPress.
  • Fully compatible with the latest version of WordPress.
  • Works with most themes and plugins that utilize the default WordPress menu structure.

sections.installation:
How It Works:

Install & Activate:
* Upload the Sleeker Editor Admin Menu plugin to your WordPress site.
* Activate the plugin from the Plugins menu in the WordPress admin panel.

Navigate to Settings:
* Go to Settings → Sleeker Editor Admin Menu.
* You will see the Editor customization page with a list of items and checkboxes.

Remove items:
* Check the boxes next to the menu items you want to remove.
* Click “Save Changes.”

Changes Apply Automatically:
* When a user with the Editor role logs in, the admin menu will be adjusted based on the settings you configured.
sections.faq:
What does Sleeker Editor Admin Menu do?

Sleeker Editor Admin Menu allows WordPress administrators to hide specific menu items for the Editor role. This helps declutter the admin panel for the Editors, improve usability, and enhance security by restricting access to unnecessary sections.

How do I configure the menu settings for the Editor role?

After installing and activating the plugin, go to Settings → Sleeker Editor Admin Menu in your WordPress dashboard. You will see the Editor customization page. Select the menu items you want to hide, and click “Save Changes” button.

Will this plugin affect administrators?

No, administrators will always see the full admin menu. The plugin only modifies the menu for the Editor role based on the settings you configure.

Does this plugin remove access to pages, or just hide the menu items for the Editor role?

This plugin only hides the menu items from the WordPress dashboard. It does not change user permissions.

Will this plugin slow down my site?

No, Sleeker Editor Admin Menu is really very lightweight and optimized for performance. It only runs in the WordPress admin area and does not affect your site’s frontend speed.

How can I reset the settings to default?

To reset the plugin settings, go to Settings → Sleeker Editor Admin Menu, uncheck all options, and click “Save Changes.” This will restore the default menu visibility for the Editor role.
